title: NEXARA Provider Runtime — Architecture Design Contract V1
principle: The system knows capabilities, not providers. Provider selection is capability-driven, scored, and fallback-safe.

p1.title: System cannot know Claude/GPT/DeepSeek
p1.principle: Capability declares need. Provider Runtime satisfies it without system awareness of provider identity.

p2.title: How are providers scored?
p2.principle: Multi-dimensional scoring. No single dimension dominates. Weights configurable per capability.

p3.title: How does failure switch providers?
p3.chain: Primary fails → circuit breaker opens → selector picks next scored → fallback exhausted → escalate to Coordinator
p3.principle: Transparent fallback. System unaware of switch. Evidence records which provider served.

provider_contract.description: A Provider is a capability-fulfilling model endpoint. Defined abstractly — no hardcoded provider names.

provider_registry.description: Registry of all available providers. Capability Runtime queries by capability_id, not provider name.
provider_registry.existing: ModelRouter._PROVIDERS dict (ProviderInfo) — to be wrapped, not replaced

provider_router.description: Routes capability requests to scored providers. Wraps existing ModelRouter.
provider_router.existing: ModelRouter.route() already does tier selection + circuit breaker + cost estimate. Provider Runtime adds capability mapping + multi-dim scoring.

routing_pipeline.name: Capability Resolution
routing_pipeline.action: CapabilityResolver → capability_id + required attributes (context_window, latency_max, cost_budget)

routing_pipeline.name: Multi-Dim Scoring
routing_pipeline.action: Score each candidate on 6 dimensions. Filter out those below minimum threshold.

routing_pipeline.name: Health Gate
routing_pipeline.action: Remove providers with open circuit breaker OR failed health check

routing_pipeline.name: Selection
routing_pipeline.action: Pick highest-scored provider. Record as primary. Next as fallback.

capability_match.description: How well does this provider's model match the capability requirements?

context_window.description: Context window size vs mission requirement

historical_success.description: Historical success rate for this capability

provider_adapter.description: Uniform interface for all providers. Implements ModelProvider Protocol from model_gateway.py.

interface.complete: (system: str, task: str, context: dict, *, trace_id: str, timeout_s: float) → ModelResponse
interface.name: provider name (string)

provider_adapter.implementations: One adapter per (provider, model) pair. All adapters conform to ModelProvider Protocol.

rules.description: R3+ missions require pro-tier providers only
rules.enforcement: filter out flash-tier providers for R3+

rules.description: Provider context window must fit mission requirements

cost_control.budget_enforcement: Per-mission token budget from mission contract retry_policy. Enforced at routing time.
cost_control.cost_tracking: Every ModelResponse includes cost_usd. Summed per mission. Alert Coordinator at 80/90/100% budget.
cost_control.circuit_breaker: Existing CircuitBreaker from model_router.py. Per-provider failure counting. Opens at threshold=3, cooldown=60s.

fallback_strategy.primary_fails: Circuit breaker opens → selector picks next scored provider
fallback_strategy.all_high_tier_exhausted: Fall back to standard tier if mission risk allows (R0-R2 only)
fallback_strategy.all_providers_exhausted: CapabilityResolver walks fallback_chain to lower-tier capability
fallback_strategy.complete_exhaustion: Transition mission to BLOCKED. Notify Coordinator with PROVIDER_EXHAUSTED code.
fallback_strategy.evidence: Every fallback step recorded. Final routing decision includes full fallback chain trace.

health_check.liveness: Optional ping before selection. provider_health dict from ModelRouter.route()
health_check.circuit_breaker: Primary health gate. Open breaker = provider unavailable.
health_check.historical: Reliability score from ProviderSelector scoring. Degrades with failures, recovers with successes.

pr24_capability_mapping.hermes_writer: cap.code.write → prov.deepseek (deepseek-v4-pro). cap.evidence.generate → no model needed.
pr24_capability_mapping.agentos_coordinator: cap.orchestrate → no model needed. cap.gate.evaluate → no model needed.
pr24_capability_mapping.note: In PR24, Claude was the REVIEWER agent name — not the provider. Provider was deepseek-v4-pro for all model calls.

integration.above: Capability Runtime — declares capability_id, required attributes
integration.existing: ModelRouter, CircuitBreaker, ProviderInfo, ModelProvider Protocol — all reused
